entity.summary: Self-custodial EVM wallet ecosystem from Ambire, currently centered on its browser extension with EOA and smart-account capabilities.
entity.notes: Ambire's current first-party material repeatedly describes Ambire Wallet and its extension as self-custodial. The older web-wallet lineage predates the current extension, so entity launch remains unresolved here.

products.summary: Current self-custodial Ambire Wallet browser extension supporting EOAs, smart accounts and hardware-wallet signers.
products.notes: First-party launch announcement states the extension became publicly available without invite codes on 2025-05-08. Older Ambire Web Wallet remains separate historical product lineage.

evidence.title: How To Make The Most Out Of Ambire Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party Ambire article explicitly describes Ambire as a self-custodial Web3 wallet.

evidence.title: The Ambire Extension Launches Officially
evidence.notes: First-party announcement establishes the public Ambire Extension launch on 2025-05-08 and its self-custody mission.
